featured_reviews.name: ashish biswas
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been suffering form sciatica pain for past 6-7 years. At its worst, I couldn’t stand for more than a minute because of the shooting pain radiating into my left leg. Met 3 surgeons and had even confirmed a discectomy surgery an operation at Lilavati.
At this stage, I had already tried physio therapy at various places.
Prior to surgery, as a last ditch attempt with Medical Yoga, I visited Yogasrishti where Kiran worked on my case in a meticulous manner. The treatment was initially rope-pulling based traction to relax the compression on my spine. And then slowly exercises were prescribed. Initially progress was slow, but Kiran kept my spirits up with her positive outlook. It took 2-3 months for the pain to go. And a month or so later, the pain even came back, perhaps because I wasn’t careful, but each time Kiran was there to support me back to normalcy.
Now am pain free for over a month, and making sure I do my exercises at home regularly. And always aware that I need to be careful. Thanks to Kiran and Yogasrishti for helping me avoid surgery (so far 🤞🏽)! Highly recommend this to anyone who wants to give conservative methods one last try before going under the surgeons’s knife.

featured_reviews.name: Anagha Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am under medication for pulmonary pneumonitis for the last three years and I have to take steroid  to enhance my lung capacity.

One day, I was constantly coughing due to short breath. I was sweating and feeling unwell. Kiran made me lie down on  pillows in a special way to widen my lungs. Within minutes, I felt very calm and fell asleep. This experience led me to join the YogaSrishti.

I have been taking yoga therapy for the last five months under the guidance of Kiran and Sonal. I still remember first session with  Sonal. She explained my illness on the base of science and boosted my confidence.

Sonal and Kiran kindly encouraged me and gave excellent and comfortable yoga therapy as per my capacity. After every session, I felt a positive change in myself.

Previously, I would be short of breath and constantly tired even while doing daily activities, but regular yoga therapy at YogaSrishti has improved my ability to move around in my daily life and in other physical activities too.

The hard work of Sonal and Kiran put it on me results into my latest chest scan reports that came this month has shown a lot of improvement and as per the advice of the chest physician, I will not need steroids anymore.

Thank you Kiran and Sonal.🙏🙏

featured_reviews.name: LS RATHOD
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot thank Sonal and Kiran Choudhary enough for the incredible care and therapy they provided for my mother. She had been suffering from severe body pain in her hand, spine, and chest for a long time, compounded by the after-effects of a stroke she experienced two years ago. Her condition was so challenging that she couldn’t even walk independently. Despite consulting various doctors and trying multiple medications, nothing brought her lasting relief.
When we brought her to our home in Mumbai and started Medical Yoga therapy with Sonal and Kiran, we were amazed at the results. Within just a few days, my mother began to feel relief from her pain. Now, after 20 sessions, she is completely pain-free, mobile, and much happier.
Seeing her regain her independence and smile again is priceless. I wholeheartedly recommend Sonal and Kiran’s Medical Yoga therapy to anyone looking for an effective, compassionate, and holistic solution. They have truly made a transformative difference in our lives. Thank you so much

My pain decreased noticeably, and she expertly corrected my posture, allowing me to stand and walk for longer periods than I ever thought possible.
